items.name: StripChart
items.what: A real result against its random baseline, one row per measure, with mean, spread, confidence interval and reference marks on a shared axis.

items.name: MiniStrip
items.what: One axis-free row of the strip chart: a real value against its baseline, for findings strips and small cards.

items.name: NetworkView
items.what: An SVG network with hubs, labels, groups, legend, highlighted links and optional zoom, arrowheads, circle layout and clickable nodes.

items.name: EChart
items.what: An ECharts chart at the site's type sizes and colours, with tooltips and resize handling.

items.name: Figure
items.what: A chart with its caption and its numbers in a closed table drawer.

items.name: Table
items.what: A plain table with en-GB numbers and right-aligned numeric columns, drawn with Week 4's bars and meters.

items.name: DecoratedTable
items.what: A table with the classes and inline bars or meters that Week 4's table decorator would give it, worked out from the cell text.

items.name: Concordance
items.what: A key-word-in-context table: one row per hit with left context, the hit and right context, linked to the Wikipedia page.

items.name: Passage
items.what: A quoted passage from one page with every occurrence of a word highlighted.

items.name: TermText
items.what: Script-built text whose first match of a phrase becomes a glossary term with a pop-up definition.

items.name: TipBox
items.what: A chart tooltip placed beside the pointer and kept inside its host.

items.name: HoverTipHost
items.what: A chart host with instant tooltips on every kit chart mark inside it.

items.name: VectorAngle
items.what: Two vectors from the origin with the angle between them, the cosine readout, and a slider that scales one vector without changing the cosine.

items.name: SplitBars
items.what: Ranked rows, each a bar split into coloured parts, with a value, a status pill and a legend.

items.name: SweepCurve
items.what: A small line chart of a parameter sweep with a dashed reference line and a marker at the current value.

items.name: TokenWindow
items.what: A sentence as token chips with the centre word and its context window, then the positive and negative training pairs for skip-gram or CBOW.

items.name: CountMatrix
items.what: A word-context count table tinted by count, with count, PPMI, TF or TF-IDF transforms and the highlighted row written out as a vector.

items.name: MixtureBar
items.what: A 100% bar of topic shares, a card per topic, and the top word probabilities for the focused topic.

items.name: RankedBars
items.what: A numbered ranking with one bar per row on a shared scale and extra columns.

items.name: AxisMap
items.what: A scatter with named axis ends, highlighted and searchable points, optional log axes and a y = x diagonal.

items.name: AnalogyPlot
items.what: Word arithmetic in three steps: four words, the a-to-b offset drawn again from c, and where c + (b - a) lands next to its nearest word.

items.name: GuessRanker
items.what: A describe-without-naming round: the reader types words one at a time and a live top ten shows where the target ranks.

items.name: NetCanvas
items.what: A canvas network for 200 to 2,000 nodes with layouts that tween, group or sequential colour, tooltips and small multiples.

items.name: StepPlayer
items.what: Step, play, pause, reset and speed controls around any seeded process, so a seed replays the same run.

items.name: Readouts
items.what: A row of labelled numbers with optional notes, announced politely when they change.

items.name: TaggedTokens
items.what: A row of token chips with tags beneath, tone colours, boxed spans and an optional n-gram window.

items.name: ContributionBars
items.what: Signed bars from a zero line, one per word, with a gauge for their sum or sigmoid.

items.name: RankedResults
items.what: Search results from several engines side by side, each with score bars, where hovering one result marks it in every column.

items.name: MethodCompare
items.what: One input under several methods, a numbered card per method side by side.

items.name: DistributionPlot
items.what: A distribution drawn raw, binned or as a CCDF on linear or log axes, with reference curves and envelopes.

items.name: NullHistogram
items.what: A permutation test as it grows: the null samples as a histogram, a line at the real value, and z and empirical p readouts.

items.name: NullBoard
items.what: A grid of small null histograms, one per measure and null model, each titled by whether the real value survives.

items.name: NullBars
items.what: Observed values against a null per category: a bar, the null mean with whiskers to 2 sd, and z.

items.name: graph-core
items.what: Seeded network models (G(n,p), BA, Watts-Strogatz), BFS, centralities, clustering, Louvain stepper and layouts, tested against networkx.

items.name: Anatomy
items.what: The 'how each section reads' box: a title, an intro line and a list of terms with what each means.

items.name: Card
items.what: A card container with its classes, id and style.

items.name: ClosingCard
items.what: The closing card: the takeaway, the one limit as a notice, an optional next step, and the methods and AI-use disclosures.

items.name: Drawer
items.what: One closed disclosure drawer that the reader opens.

items.name: Drawers
items.what: A row of drawers at the foot of a card or inline in the text.

items.name: FigRow
items.what: Two figures or plots side by side.

items.name: FindingRow
items.what: One finding: its number, the section title, the answer, a mini chart and a link to the section.

items.name: FindingsStrip
items.what: The findings under the hero: a heading with the key to the mini charts, then one row per section.

items.name: HeroStat
items.what: One big number in the hero with what it counts.

items.name: HowTo
items.what: The key to the charts: one row per mark with its swatch, name and what it shows.

items.name: Notice
items.what: A notice with an icon, an optional bold headline and its text.

items.name: Plot
items.what: A chart panel with its title, an optional axis note and the chart host.

items.name: PostHero
items.what: The hero of a post: eyebrow, title, the question, scope caution, legend, hero stats and the page's figure.

items.name: PostSection
items.what: A post section with its id and owner.

items.name: QaDisclosure
items.what: A disclosure with its cue in the summary and its body, never rendered open.

items.name: QuestionCard
items.what: The section card: the question, what we did, what to notice and the figure beside or below, then the drawers.

items.name: QuestionHeader
items.what: The question at the top of a card with an optional number and its short answer, or a kicker line.

items.name: SectionOpener
items.what: The header that opens a section: its number, its title and the finding in one line.

items.name: SectionRail
items.what: The section rail down the left margin: one dot per section and its questions, marking the one in view and showing every name on hover.

items.name: SegmentedControl
items.what: A row of buttons that picks one value, with arrow-key, Home and End navigation.

items.name: Term
items.what: A glossary term: the word as a button with a pop-up definition on hover and focus.

items.name: Termified
items.what: Server prose whose glossary terms are placed once the page has hydrated and its data has loaded.

items.name: W4Figure
items.what: A Week 4 figure with a caption (bold title, then the reading) and the chart bodies.

items.name: Panel (Week 5 search panel)
items.what: A titled panel holding a section's controls, results and caption.

items.name: BrandMark
items.what: The site's name as a link home.

items.name: PostTopbar
items.what: The bar across the top of a post: the brand, the All posts link and the section links.

items.name: SiteFooter
items.what: The footer with credits, the page's name and the link home.

items.name: Prediction prompt
items.what: A number box and slider that follow each other, a reveal button and feedback; the first guess is saved and a reveal unlocks the page.

items.name: Logbook
items.what: The arcade header and the logbook dialog that lists the first guesses saved in this browser.

items.name: Pack machine

items.name: Equal-chance comparison
items.what: Two bars comparing distinct cards collected under the real draw and under equal chances, for a chosen number of packs.

items.name: Pack estimate
items.what: A scored prediction of how many packs it takes, saved as the reader's first guess.

items.name: In-degree against out-degree (static)

items.name: Strikeforce: Morituri island (static)
items.what: Directed drawing of the nine characters outside the giant component.

items.name: Close a station
items.what: Pick an article to remove, predict the disruption, and reveal how many articles are stranded compared with the alternatives.

items.name: Journey ticket

items.name: Removal results (static)
items.what: Horizontal bars of other articles stranded after one removal.

items.name: Stranded counts under rewiring (static)

items.name: Journey planner
